text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During summer camp, Yaeno Muteki
trains
rigorously in preparation for the
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Osu! Thank you!
choice_data_list: Target time cleared! Let's take a ...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, you taking a break too, Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I bet she's keeping you busy, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Bamboo Memory. She's energetic,
polite,
and a member of the disciplinary
committee to
boot.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hi there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And this is Gold City. Known for her
work as a fashion model, it's no wonder
she attracts a lot of
attention at the
beach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Yaeno Muteki and Bamboo Memory are
peers competing in the
Twinkle Series, Gold City
is in the year
above them.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
City was just telling me how amazing
Tamamo is!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Tamamo has had an
astonishing
amount of press lately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross—also known as White 
Lightning—is a runner who suddenly
made a name for herself last year,
around the end of her classic
year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having grown up without much money, Tamamo
Cross's resilience in overcoming
adversity to pursue her dreams has
captured people's hearts and driven her
rise in popularity.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I competed in all three Classic Triple
Crown races,
so I never thought I'd lose
to Tamamo.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But she was just so... overwhelming in
the spring
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's why this year you're all in on
summer camp,
right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, you know. It's the only way I can
catch up to Tamamo and keep up with
my modeling as well.
I'll win next time,
for sure.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, everyone in your
year is
getting all excited about Oguri,
aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hers is a real success story—she's a
country girl
who made it to the
nationals.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If she keeps on winning, her popularity's
bound to
skyrocket, right?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of, Yaeno, didn't you compete
against
Oguri in the Mainichi Hai? How
was that?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Indeed. When I think back to her...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(It didn't feel like she had a distinctly
intimidating
aura.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(She was as serene as still water and ran
naturally,
calm and composed.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(She was like a mountain reflecting
radiant
sunshine.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Or pure flowing water.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Driven by the overpowering instinct to
simply
run, she raced ahead as if it was
only natural to
do so.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (She was in a state of absolute zen...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Her state of mind was the sort a warrior
aspires to achieve before battle. I see
now... That's the
aura that enveloped
her.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Is that why I felt our confrontation
to be

inevitable? Was it her spirit washing over
me? )

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Um, Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Oh, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oguri and I run in entirely different
ways. You
might say that her running
style is the exact
opposite of mine.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Really? So how strong is she?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I perceive her abilities as being
sage-like
in
nature.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Sage-like?! So Oguri must be insanely
strong,
huh?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You'd never guess, just looking at her
now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I glance over to where Gold City is
indicating...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's on a winning streak, and
there's no
doubt she's got talent.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how about we do some group
training? We
can come up with a
strategy to beat Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm... Very well.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Count me in. I'm sure I'll be up against
Oguri
sooner or later, so I may as well.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Nice! It's decided!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. What kind of training would you

recommend?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as we're at the beach, we should
do some
training that takes advantage
of the sandy
environment, so...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
How exactly does watermelon splitting
constitute
training?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being blindfolded makes even walking in a
straight line tough. You need both a
high level of
concentration and
impeccable balance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
True, some martial arts training involves
standing on one leg with your eyes
closed to improve balance. Training
without the benefits of sight could yield
good results.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's get ready!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo! You're turning further and
further to the
left!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Raise your right shoulder and straighten
your
body. ...Ah, now it's too high!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Waaah! I can't stand still!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh. How did you two walk so straight
like that?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well, I am a model. I'm used to walking straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You must learn to perceive with your
other
senses, not just your eyes. That's a
fundamental
aspect of martial arts.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nghhh! I refuse to lose! I'm gonna nail
this
training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After their productive training session,
everyone
enjoys the sweet and
refreshing watermelon
together.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm okay with beach flags, but why is it
necessary
to wear socks?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Going barefoot makes it possible to grip
the sand with your toes, so it's even
easier than running in shoes. The idea is
that wearing socks will make it
harder.
choice_data_list: Because it makes it harder to grip...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that socks will also make them
more
likely to slip, so this exercise will
make for good
footwork training.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! So you can ramp up the challenge
that
way, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I don't remember if I brought extra
socks... Well, I
guess I can just wash
these ones after.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's get ready.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yesss! The flag is miiiiine!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Argh! I'm definitely gonna get it next
time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki and the others continue
running up and down the beach until
their white socks are
completely covered
in sand.
